line: Answer a few questions. Get a finished website.
sub: An agent skill. It asks, builds, checks the site in your own browser, and asks before it publishes.

concepts.name: Answers in the address bar
concepts.idea: Every site sits in a browser window whose address bar holds the answers that made it; the try-it questions fill the bar and open the real site.
concepts.bold: one big browser window running a real example site, its bar reading the answers

concepts.name: Six questions, six sites
concepts.idea: The first screen is the six answer sets as a list, each row opening the site it made.
concepts.line: Six sets of answers. Six websites.
